lines.trans: This place really has not changed a bit—ten years ago today, I came right here too.
Ten years ago you were thirteen, so you must have come here with your parents.
If only I had not come here… Have you heard of street casting?
Does regretting coming here mean you do not like the life you have now?
I know well there are busy, exhausting parts, yet I believe there are unmistakably good parts too.
Nothing remains in my life now except going downhill—I am barely twenty-three, yet all I have ever done is climb up.
Whenever my mother hears singer Jeon Young-rok's songs, her heart still flutters happily remembering the sweet days when she was young and in love.
Could a star who defines an era perhaps be a symbol of that entire time?
Even if someday you no longer shine the way you do now, whenever people hear your songs they will fondly recall the brightest days of their lives alongside you.
Maybe that really is true—I had never thought about it that way.
My mom loved actor Leslie Cheung, and she said my dad had to bring her a hundred chocolates from his commercials just to date her.

meanings.note: Determiner form of 하나, used before a noun counter.

examples.trans: one person
one hour

examples.text: 여기서 선택을 못 받아서 낙오되신 분들은 신입 피디와 함께 갑니다.
examples.trans: Anyone not chosen here and left behind will travel with our rookie producer.

examples.text: 함께 준비하면 좋은 결과가 있을 거예요.
examples.trans: If we prepare (together), we will get good results.
I want to even try right now.
How about trying to even try together tomorrow?

examples.text: 잘 가라, 준모는 성질 내놓고도 맘 약해서 십오 초 만에 후회할 거면서.
examples.trans: Off you go—even when Joon-mo loses his temper, he is too soft-hearted and regrets it within fifteen seconds anyway.
This expression comes from 'will regret'.
It really is find it hard, so compared to what I thought.
Especially today, it is find it hard, so and nice.
